reasoning: This is a system status-bar indicator showing zero signal bars (an empty wedge) on a locked Wi-Fi network, rather than a standard concentric-arc Wi-Fi symbol. Because it represents a specific device signal state (0 of 4 bars, locked) and the hollow wedge is less recognizable out of status-bar context than standard Wi-Fi arcs, a normal Wi-Fi or router icon is always preferable for tasks.
